projects.description: Sovereign digital workspace stack. A federated repository for developing and running web services and AI agents on infrastructure you control, built on data sovereignty, system immutability, and workspace-wide compliance.
Practical guardrails for coding agents: required git hooks, banned-pattern scanning, quality gates, and this wiki for browsing the workspace's projects, policies, standards, and tooling.

Multi-tenant LLM gateway on Apache APISIX for shared LLM traffic with virtual key sharding, spend limits, PII redaction, and built-in safety and moderation. Ships Grafana dashboards for cost, usage, and operations.
projects.grafanaSubtitle: Real-time metrics for the multi-tenant LLM gateway - routing, token accounting, PII redaction, and provider health across all upstream AI models.

projects.description: Compiled Rust guards wrapping the most abusable surfaces of an agent dev machine, vetting every git invocation for destructive history and policy bypass while containing GTFOBins-class SUID and file-capability escapes.
